Paying your gold loan in one shot at the end: why can it cost you ₹5,381 more?

Illustrative ₹1 lakh gold loan at 12% a year for 12 months:
Bullet (principal + interest at the end): ₹12,000 interest.
Monthly EMI (reducing balance): EMI ≈ ₹8,885, interest ≈ ₹6,619.
The EMI pays down principal every month, so you pay ₹5,381 less interest. Processing and valuation fees (plus 18% GST on them) come on top either way.
